inShort: A builds serve power in three steps, from a squat to a full serve with a loose wrist. B watches and listens. Then swap.
rules: A stands at the baseline with balls, B beside A to watch.
Step 1: A squats low, drops the ball, stands up into the court onto the front foot and lets the arm swing through loosely. 10 serves.
Step 2: A holds the paddle with thumb and two fingers only, so the arm can't force it. If the balls fly long, aim lower. 10 serves.

Step 3: normal grip, full serve. Wrist loose, push the butt of the paddle toward the target and let the paddle trail behind the hand; don't snap it. Slow to fast, never slowing before contact. B listens: the whoosh through contact gets louder and longer.
tooEasy: Put a shoe 1.5 m in front of the far baseline and count serves behind it with the loose arm: 8 of 10.
tooHard: Shadow swing without a ball until the motion is smooth, then add the ball.
goodLooksLike: The swing starts slow and is fastest at the ball, the paddle finishes high, and the serve lands deep.

drill.title: Serve Power — Solo Kinetic-Chain & Lag Progression
